title: Sr. Security Compliance Analyst
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

  

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

Purpose and Scope:

Help a global pharmaceutical company adopt new technology, including AI, safely. As Sr. Security Compliance Analyst, you will make sure the systems Astellas buys, builds and runs are secure from the start: setting clear security requirements, confirming they are met before go-live, and monitoring them once systems are in use. You will work with project teams, vendors and quality colleagues across the US, Europe, Japan and India, and help shape how Astellas secures emerging technology such as AI.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

Scope: Third-party and cloud (SaaS) solutions, in-house built applications and AI systems (models, agents, copilots), for both GxP (FDA/EU-regulated) and non-regulated use.

* Plan & Design: Join new projects early to identify security and compliance risks; assess vendors and cloud services before contracts are signed (e.g., SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certifications, security questionnaires); make sure contracts include the right security terms; and assess risks in new AI tools with our AI Security team.
* Requirements & Standards: Own the security requirements in Astellas' System Life Cycle (SLC), our process for delivering and validating systems, keeping them clear, testable and tied to policy and regulation (e.g., 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11); keep security standards current as policies, threats and technologies such as AI evolve; and tailor requirements to each system's type and risk.
* Build & Change: Review specifications, designs and test evidence to confirm security requirements are met before go-live and with every change; provide the security sign-off at key project checkpoints and in change control; and drive gaps to resolution or manage formal, time-limited exceptions.
* Operate & Monitor: Run periodic reviews of live systems and reassess key vendors; track open risks and exceptions through to closure; maintain the technology risk register and report on risk to leadership; run and improve risk and vendor-risk workflows in OneTrust; and, when systems or vendor relationships end, confirm access is removed and data is returned or destroyed.
* Partnership & Governance: Act as Cybersecurity's partner to our IT quality and compliance team, keeping security and quality requirements aligned and free of duplication, including for AI systems; guide and train system owners, project teams and vendors; support audits and assessments with evidence; and work with procurement, legal and quality colleagues across regions.

  

**Required Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
* 5+ years in cybersecurity compliance, IT risk or third-party risk management.
* Hands-on experience defining or reviewing security requirements for systems throughout their life cycle.
* Hands-on experience assessing the security of vendors and cloud services.
* Working knowledge of common security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53 and ISO 27001.
* Strong written English and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and business audiences across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in a GxP-regulated environment (computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5), including validation documents such as user requirements, specifications and traceability matrices.
* Experience with OneTrust (IT and third-party risk modules), ALM (requirements management) or Veeva Vault.
* Exposure to AI risk assessment and cloud/SaaS security.
* Knowledge of secure development (NIST SSDF) and supply chain risk (NIST SP 800-161) guidance.
* Certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CCSP or CTPRP.

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

title: Prod Compliance AssociateSr ML, Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(spanish) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sr. Compliance Associate(spanish), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.  
  
Skills:  

* Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
* Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
* Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
* Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
* Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
* Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
* Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data

  
About the team  
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.  
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

* 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with Excel
* Spanish B2 and above proficiency in verbal and written communication

----------------------------

* Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
* Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies

title: Director, Product Manager - Legal
description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

  

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Director, Product Manager - Legal leads a group of Legal Technology Products – spanning Legal Operations and Intellectual Property (IP) within the Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech Domain, ensuring they deliver measurable value, support business processes, and are continuously improved. They work closely with the SD, Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech to translate functional goals into product roadmaps and provide direction to Product Owners on prioritisation, delivery focus, and product performance. The Director, Legal Product Manager ensures that Legal & Compliance products are usable, compliant, secure, and efficient to operate, while fostering a culture of agile delivery, value realisation, and continuous improvement across their Product group.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

* Translate functional strategies provided by the SD, Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech into actionable product roadmaps and delivery priorities across the Legal product group – covering Legal Operations and Intellectual Property as well as the Legal AI Platform products.

* Act as the escalation point for critical product performance, delivery issues, and dependency conflicts, addressing risks and facilitating decisions.
* Champion the adoption of user-centred improvements, Legal business process optimisation, and automation/AI opportunities that reduce cycle time and enhance user experience.
* Ensure effective, defensible, risk, security, and compliance management (e.g. ISO controls, GDPR, legal privilege, Information governance requirements) across the Legal product group, embedding relevant controls in partnership with Security, Risk, Legal and Compliance SMEs.
* Support Solution Architects in shaping cross-product and cross-platform solutions, ensuring Product Owners manage dependencies to deliver integrated outcomes.
* Track and report performance against agreed KPIs for the Legal product group, driving continuous improvement activities to maximise value for the Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech Domain.
* Provide financial oversight of the Legal product group, including product budgets and internal/external team resourcing costs, to inform strategic decision‑making and ensure alignment with GSK’s financial objectives.
* Lead Innovation agenda across the Legal & IP products ensuring we are running a top quartile technology stack. Includes staying abreast of advancements of the Legal technology ecosystem
* Ensure investment requests in Legal technology follow the Legal & Compliance Tech & AI board governance, and partner with business leaders to develop robust plans and robust designs as part of approval processes.
* Champion the use of AI, automation and technology in the Legal & Compliance function
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience
* Extensive experience 18+ years overseeing end-to-end product delivery, including prioritisation, backlog management, solution design support, testing oversight, and value-focused release planning – with clear focus on Legal Tech
* Proven track record in overseeing the definition and execution of Legal technology systems in a company of similar size and scale to GSK, realising tangible benefits for the Business.
* Deep experience in concurrently overseeing multiple Product teams across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements elicitation through to release.
* Proficient in conveying complex technology ideas to non-conversant audiences.
* Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing Product use cases and determining their associated value.
* Highly experienced team leader that can effectively manage small to medium IT delivery teams.
* Very strong communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders, aligning on competing priorities and guiding Business teams on the feasibility of requests vs. technology constraints.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to guide prioritisation decisions, resolve delivery conflicts, and align multiple stakeholders around shared product outcomes.
* Skilled in coaching and developing Product Owners, fostering a culture of user-centred design, value-based delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Able to interpret business processes, regulatory needs, and operational insights to identify optimisation and automation opportunities that enhance product performance and user experience.
Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and compliance constraints, ensuring product changes are well controlled, supportable, and aligned to organisational standards.  

**Skills**

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Digital Transformation, Generative AI, Information Governance, Intellectual Property, Legal Technology, Product Management Leadership

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Applied Scientist II, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.  
  
The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.  
  
You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.  
  
The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
* Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
* Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
* Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
* Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
* Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
* Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
* Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow

  
About the team  
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.  
  
RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:  

* Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
* Management of existing business risks across the organization
* Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
* Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
* A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
